speaker: god
text: I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will destroy you, and no one will be left.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, as surely as I live,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.
name: The LORD

speaker: nineveh
text: I am it, and there is none besides me,
name: Nineveh

speaker: god
text: I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore wait for Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation— all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.
name: The LORD

speaker: people
text: Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
name: The people

speaker: people
text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.
name: The people

speaker: god
text: I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,
name: The LORD
